QuestInfo.0: Recycle your useless Valentine's Day Chocolates.
QuestInfo.1: Recycle your useless Valentine's Day Chocolates.

0.0: We are wrapping up this Valentine's Day thing. I'm so tired of all the hugs and sweet letters I'm getting... Okay, not really, but I AM tired of the chocolate. You wanna help me get rid of all the leftovers?

yes.0: Yaaay, I was worried I was going to gain another 30 pounds. Go eliminate some monsters in your level range and collect #b#e30 #t3994721##k#n pieces, and bring them back to me for DESTRUCTION.

no.0: What? Is it because of all the chocolate acne I have? I KNEW I should have worn a face scarf today.

default.0: Good. Now go eliminate some monsters in your level range and collect #b#e30 #t3994721##k#n.
